title: Tong Duc Thanh Nam — Full-stack TypeScript Engineer
description: A Software Engineer portfolio built in a hybrid editorial identity: warm bone surfaces, ink type, a single rebar-terracotta accent, and a 3D AI workstation as the hero signature. Fraunces serif over Manrope body and Space Mono metadata, with Lenis + GSAP motion, a floating ink monitor that types product evidence above a low isometric paper keyboard, a minimal dot+ring cursor, a pinned why-choose scroll story, animated skill bars, and cursor-following project previews.
author: agent

contest.ambition: A clean Software Engineer portfolio that argues for the candidate using the candidate's own medium: a looping 3D AI workstation as the first-viewport signature, over a hybrid editorial identity (bone/ink/rebar palette, Fraunces/Manrope/Space Mono). It deliberately drops the borrowed drafting metaphor of the source demo and replaces it with a signature no benchmark offers, while keeping the conventional CV narrative (why, about, experience, skills, work, contact) and dense factual work rows.
